name: مرجع الفروع المتعددة (مزامنة سحابية)
buyer: REFERENCE ONLY: partners who co-own a small multi-branch service business; not a real customer
problem: Branch data is invisible to owners until someone sends files; when the office PC is off nobody can record work.
core_journey: Branch staff record attendance and receipts offline, devices sync through the hub, every owner sees per-branch totals with freshness and acts by permission.

data.backup_restore_plan: Hub point-in-time restore with epoch bump, plus main-PC local backup restored on a clean PC.
data.residency: PENDING owner decision: hosting region and Egypt Law 151/2020 transfer review

acceptance: Main PC switched off: two other devices keep recording and the owner sees their totals after they sync.
Two devices edit the same student phone offline: one deterministic result, the other kept in audit.
A user revoked while a phone is offline cannot have new receipts accepted by the hub.
One owner cannot remove the other owner without quorum.
